Technology stocks were softer in recent trading, with the shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 losing 1.8% in value, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was falling almost 0.7%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(-) SPI Energy ( SPI ) fell almost 21% to a worst-ever $0.87 cents a share after the photovoltaic panels manufacturer said the Nasdaq Stock Market warned that its stock was at risk of being delisted after the company's floating market capitalization was below the Nasdaq market's $15 million minimum threshold.
In other sector news:
(+) DropCar Inc. ( DCAR ) sped as much as 65% higher on Monday after the automotive logistics software company announced plans to sell its Suisun Operations unit to selected members of Suisun's current management team for $3.5 million in cash.
(-) Canadian Solar ( CSIQ ) declined nearly 2.2% on Monday. The company announced a 10-year power purchase agreement with Germany's TrailStone GmbH for electricity produced using its solar-power facilities in Sicily.
